method.counters: Observed after each actual simulation tick. Cargo/shot values count actor/effect observations; hauling deliveries require cargo-to-empty transition near owner camp.
method.fixture: Exact copied busy fixture and helpers from tests/benchmark_campaign.gd, except TimedSimulation subclass. 32 friendly actors, 100 enemies, connected salvage hauling, powered production, three paid building orders and one paid road order. Increased actor/building HP retains the workload; this is not balanced-combat evidence.
method.frame_scope: Wall intervals between successive RenderingServer.frame_post_draw signals from the actual native main scene, including real world/HUD drawing, main processing and renderer/presentation pacing. This is not a physical display scanout measurement.
method.limits: Local native editor-capable runtime, not an exported build or minimum hardware claim. OS and other processes are uncontrolled. Quick/prepare runs validate fixture only and cannot substantiate performance. The harness does not move the cursor or change desktop display modes.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank over individual measured frames/ticks; FPS is measured frame count / total measured interval, not mean instantaneous FPS.
method.render_scope: RenderingServer viewport render CPU/GPU and frame setup CPU milliseconds where supported. These exclude game scripts; zero values may mean unavailable backend instrumentation. Performance process/physics monitors are engine-reported samples, not additive isolated subsystem times.
method.screenshots: Saved after the measured interval; GPU readback/PNG encoding is excluded from sampled frame intervals. RSS probes occur before/after each zoom, outside sampled intervals.
method.simulation_scope: Actual main._process accumulator invokes the timed subclass of campaign_simulation.tick(0.05) at 20 Hz. Each tick timer wraps only super.tick; workload observation follows that timer and is included in wall intervals.
